description: Close the section 5 payment-verification/recovery gaps that remain OPEN after the audit: R3/N3 durable quarantine intake with recoverable lease/retry/ack semantics, and N2 wallet top-up binding. The webhook already re-verifies capture against Razorpay and uses lease-based dedup, so this is additive hardening, not a rewrite. No AWS deploy (code + tests only).
steps: In amplify/functions/payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py, replace the alert-only _quarantine_unverified_capture with a durable intake: persist an unresolved-capture row (reference_id, payment_id, outcome category, created_at, lease/ack fields) to a quarantine/reconciliation table following the existing WebhookDedup/order_keys conditional-write pattern, so an acknowledged event remains recoverable after Razorpay stops retrying. Keep it writing NOTHING financial. Add a recoverable job marker consistent with scripts/reconcile_file_deliveries.py style.

Harden the wallet top-up branch of _handle_payment_captured (notes.purpose == 'wallet_topup'): require a stored customer/top-up intent row, verify the captured amount against Razorpay's API (razorpay_verify) rather than trusting the event body notes, bind the credit to the stored intent, and guard the credit with an idempotency marker so one captured payment credits exactly once.

Add/extend tests: tests/test_razorpay_webhook_captured_gating.py or a new tests/test_quarantine_recovery.py asserting (a) a rejected/unknown commerce outcome writes a durable quarantine row and NO financial side effect, (b) the quarantined event is recoverable after acknowledgment, (c) a wallet top-up without a stored intent is NOT credited, (d) a provider-verified top-up credits exactly once and a duplicate delivery does not double-credit.
Confirm no new secret appears in any log expression (type(exc).__name__ only) per secret-handling steering.
acceptance_criteria: An explicit rejected/conflicting/unknown commerce outcome produces a durable, recoverable quarantine record and zero financial writes, asserted by a passing test
Wallet top-up credit requires a stored intent AND provider-verified amount, and is idempotent across duplicate deliveries, asserted by passing tests
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q stays green with the new tests, 0 failed
findings: Committed as 39d84695 on branch stack. Changed: amplify/functions/payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py (durable quarantine + hardened _handle_wallet_topup_captured), amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/order_keys.py (new recoverable primitives: record_/resolve_/acknowledge_capture_quarantine, reserve_/resolve_topup_intent, claim_topup_credit), amplify/functions/messaging/partner-onboarding/handler.py (_do_topup_order reserves a stored top-up intent + referenceId before creating the Razorpay payment link), scripts/reconcile_captures.py (recoverable job: report/ack parked captures), tests/test_quarantine_recovery.py (9 new tests covering a-d). NO NEW TABLE NEEDED: both the quarantine intake and the top-up intent/credit markers reuse the existing commerce-keys table (commerce_keys_table_name -> WixOrderIds, single string partition orderId, TTL disabled) with new key prefixes CAPTUREQUARANTINE#/TOPUPINTENT#/TOPUPCREDIT#, matching order_keys' existing conditional-write markers; so there is no BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT deploy step. Verification RUN: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_razorpay_webhook_captured_gating.py tests/test_payment_reconciliation_safety.py -q -> 31 passed; full suite .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -> 5653 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed (adds 9 tests in test_quarantine_recovery.py; the suite stayed green). Secret-handling: all new log lines use type(exc).__name__ for exceptions and only correlation ids (paymentId/referenceId/wabaId) + integer amountPaise + stage; no event-body dump, no secret, no float amount. Did NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles that).
